select count(*) as aggregate from "school_closures" where "school_closures"."school_year_id" = ? and "school_closures"."school_year_id" is not null and "school_closures"."masjid_id" = ?

select count(*) as aggregate from "attendance_records" where "masjid_id" = ? and strftime('%Y-%m-%d', "session_date") >= cast(? as text) and strftime('%Y-%m-%d', "session_date") <= cast(? as text) and "attendance_records"."masjid_id" = ?
select * from "forms" where "masjid_id" = ? and "forms"."deleted_at" is null
select * from "masjids" where "masjids"."id" = ? and "masjids"."deleted_at" is null limit 1
select * from "school_years" where "masjid_id" = ? and "school_years"."masjid_id" = ? order by "first_day" asc
